title: Policy
description: A security policy containing rules for evaluating agent actions.

default_outcome.description: What to do when no rule matches. Defaults to deny (fail-closed).

description.description: Description of what this policy enforces.

extends.description: Optional list of base policies to extend. Base policy rules are appended after this policy's rules, so this policy's rules take priority (first-match wins). Values can be built-in names ("postgres", "github", "slack", "shell", "default", "strict", "permissive", "filesystem") or file paths.

rules.description: The rules in this policy, evaluated in order.

version.description: Version of this policy (for tracking changes).

Condition.description:
A conditional expression for matching action parameters.

Conditions allow more expressive matching than regex patterns, supporting equality checks, containment, numeric comparisons, and more.

field.description: The parameter key to check (dot-notation for nested: "args.path").

ConditionOperator.description:
Canonical comparison operators for conditions.

These 10 operators form the cross-engine canonical set shared by the Rust SDK, TypeScript SDK, and SHIELD evaluator.

oneOf.description: String field contains value as substring.
String field starts with the given prefix.
String field ends with the given suffix.
String field matches a regular expression.
Field value is contained in the given array.
Field value is NOT contained in the given array.
URL/hostname field is within the given domain (or one of the given domains).
URL/hostname field is NOT within the given domain (or any of the given domains).

DefaultOutcome.description: What to do when no rule matches.

oneOf.description: Allow the action when no rule matches.
Deny the action when no rule matches (default, fail-closed).

Effect.description: The effect of a matched rule.

oneOf.description: Deny the action with a reason.

MatchCriteria.description: Criteria for matching an action to a rule.

action_types.description: Action types to match (e.g., "tool_call"). Empty = match all.

agent_ids.description: Agent IDs to match. Empty = match all agents.

conditions.description: Conditional expressions for advanced parameter matching. Each condition must be satisfied for the rule to match.

parameters.description: Parameter patterns to match (key = param name, value = regex pattern).

resources.description: Resources to match (e.g., "bash", "send_email"). Empty = match all.

Rule.description: A single rule within a policy.

effect.description: What to do when this rule matches.
